text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — reproduction for a weird duplicate-request bug in the payments sampleapp. Happens when the SDK auto-refreshes OAuth and the streaming connection reconnects mid-response. I have logs and a tiny repro.
Mia Chen: Oof. Can you paste the minimal logs? is this happening on hosted or dedicated?
Alex Kim: Hosted, us-west. Minimal log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-21T18:12:03Z] request id=rq_8a7 user=acct_42 POST /v1/generate stream start
[2026-03-21T18:12:04Z] token refresh for client=cli_7 -> new access token
[2026-03-21T18:12:04Z] client reconnect, resuming stream, retrying request rq_8a7
[2026-03-21T18:12:04Z] received request id=rq_8a7 duplicate=true
[2026-03-21T18:12:05Z] charged invoice id=inv_19 for request rq_8a7
```
This ends up creating duplicate charge for the same logical operation.
Jamal Ortiz: Sounds like an unsafe replay. Streaming + auth refresh is a classic footgun. Is the SDK sending Idempotency-Key for streaming requests?
Alex Kim: No, the sampleapp uses the streaming helper in the Node SDK and we only attach Idempotency-Key for non-streaming request paths. So the server sees 2 separate HTTP requests with same body but no idempotency header.
Sara Li: SDK parity note — Python SDK's streaming implementation does attach an idempotency header by accident (so it doesn't dup), Node doesn't. That's why this showed up in Node-only sampleapp tests.
Rob Patel: Two things to consider: 1) server-side transient dedupe tombstones for short window (30s) keyed by an opaque replay id, 2) SDK-level ephemeral replay id attached to all streaming requests so server can dedupe. Proposed header: `x-redwood-replay-id` (UUID v4) plus `Idempotency-Key` where available.
Mia Chen: For backoff we should also ensure retries after reconnect use full-jitter. Our recommended formula: `sleep = random_between(0, base * 2^attempt)` with base=150ms, cap=30s. If SDKs differ, we should sync defaults.
Alex Kim: Also edge-case: when token refresh triggers mid-stream the client reconnects and starts a fresh request immediately (attempt 0) — this bypasses jitter and leads to a thundering retry to the server. We should add a tiny randomized delay on reconnect (50-300ms) as a quick mitigation.
Jamal Ortiz: Server-side tombstone design: store `replay_id` -> request fingerprint for 30s in redis with `SETNX` and short TTL. If a duplicate arrives, return 409 or a streaming resume token. But must be careful with memory blowup in high-throughput routes.
Sara Li: Agreed. For SDKs: Node add `x-redwood-replay-id` default, Python ensure parity and make config toggleable. Add integration test in sampleapp.e2e that simulates token rotation mid-stream and asserts single charge.
Rob Patel: Example Node snippet for setting header in streaming helper: 
```
const replayId = uuidv4();
fetch(url, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
    'x-redwood-replay-id': replayId,
  },
  body: streamBody,
})
```
Also include `Idempotency-Key` for non-streaming operations.
Alex Kim: I added a failing test in the sampleapp CI: `tests/payment_stream_token_rotation.test.ts` — it asserts only one invoice created. CI shows it failing frequently locally.
deploy-bot: CI job sampleapp-e2e #782 failed: tests/payment_stream_token_rotation.test.ts (1 failed) :rotating_light:
Mia Chen: Action items: 1) Node SDK: add replay header + reconnect jitter (owner: @Rob) 2) Python SDK: check parity for header behavior (owner: @Sara) 3) Runtime: tombstone dedupe prototype (owner: @Jamal) 4) Sampleapp: add e2e flake guard and test (owner: @Alex) 5) Docs: add guidance on streaming idempotency and reconnect behavior (owner: @Mia). Can owners ack?
Rob Patel: ack — will open PR for Node by EOD, include config flag `streaming.replayGuard=true` default on.
Sara Li: ack — will add parity check + tests, target tomorrow morning.
Jamal Ortiz: ack — I'll sketch the tombstone design and run a small performance test against a dev cluster.
Alex Kim: I'll update sampleapp tests and add minimal repro to `examples/repros/stream-token-rotation`.
Mia Chen: I'll write the short doc section and a checklist for oncall: how to identify replay duplicates (log patterns, invoice dup signature).
Alex Kim: Thanks all. If anyone sees a different repro path (e.g., websocket-based client), ping me. I'll try to reduce the flakiness further.
Rob Patel: One more thing — let's default jitter to use full-jitter with base=150ms in both SDKs. Mentioned numbers in the PR.
Sara Li: Nice. Also add telemetry metric `replay.detected` and `replay.ignored` so we can measure the impact.
Alex Kim: Filing a lightweight RFC thread later with the design choices; will link it here.
